[[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation's]] '''G2-GE beamdrill''' was a fairly generic mid-size [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] [[Beamdrill/Legends|cutting device]] used primarily for mining.

==Characteristics==
The G2-GE was a medium-size [[Beamdrill/Legends|beamdrill]] manufactured by [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]]. It was mainly intended for use in [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations, but could cut through other materials such as [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]] and waste material. Designed to be operated by a single worker, the beamdrill was mounted on a [[repulsor platform]] which allowed the apparatus to move at a speed of fifteen [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. A visual scanner was built into the G2-GE that warned the operator of any nearby objects or individuals within a range of twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. An integrated [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] could be used to coordinate the actions of teams of workers during operation of the beamdrill.<ref name="EGWT" />

[[Power cell/Legends|Power cells]] charged catalysts within the G2-GE, which in turn ignited the [[Fuel slug/Legends|fuel slugs]] causing a conversion reaction. The resultant energy passed into the beamdrill's [[beam actuator]] to create an energized [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] cutting beam. The plasma beam's length was variable, and could be adjusted from one [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeter]] to a one and a half meters. A rotating joint allows for a one-hundred-and-eighty degree arc of movement, and the entire beamdrill could be programmed to follow pre-placed [[sensor strip]]s for precise cutting along a pre-determined path.<ref name="EGWT" />

The G2-GE was powered by three cylindrical fuel slugs that provided energy for ten hours of operation. Safety features were built in the G2-GE; numerous [[Cooling unit/Legends|cooling units]] and [[cooling coil]]s were used to disperse the heat buildup in the beamdrill. The beamdrill had emergency cutoff switches and would also automatically shut down if the operator stepped off the repulsor platform.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
The G2-GE was modified to add a [[Life support/Legends|life-support]] bubble and a small [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] so that it could be used in [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. This model was known as the [[G2-GS]].<ref name="EGWT" />
